# Welcome

Hi — this site is a small portfolio of work in R, spatial analysis, and address matching.

## Active projects

- [gnafr](https://kylehaynes.github.io/gnafr/) — active package for fuzzy matching Australian address text.
- [fast.string](https://kylehaynes.github.io/fast.string/) — string processing utilities and tools.

This site is maintained in Quarto and published to GitHub Pages from the `docs/` folder. The interactive app content has been removed so the site stays focused on published Quarto pages.
